d:
Tune in to this melodious song Taron Ki Ankhon Ka from the movie Phoolon Ki Sej (1964) starring Vyjayanthimala, Ashok Kumar and Manoj Kumar in the lead along with others.
Movie: Phoolon Ki Sej
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar
Music: P. Adinarayana Rao
Lyrics: Hasrat Jaipuri
Cast: Vyjayanthimala, Ashok Kumar, Manoj Kumar
Director: Inder Raj Anand
